summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/ (platform-specific zip), extracts and chmods the `bun` binary to 0755, then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB opaque bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` with obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array obfuscation (shifter function, hex-named identifiers, large dictionary/dispatcher body). It is not referenced by the package's declared `main` (`index.js`) and is only reachable through the preinstall dropper. An ESLint configuration package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an obfuscated bundle at install time. The Node-side `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated, hiding the flow from Node-only scanners. Installing this version causes attacker-chosen code to run on the installer's host under a runtime the package downloads for that purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
